model.formula: annual burden hours = round(hours per run × annual cycles × attributable share); attributable share = round(clamp(5% + (100 − score) × 0.70, 5%, 75%))
model.capacity_formula: people involved × 1,800 available hours per person per year
model.capacity_limit_rule: withhold annual hours, cost, capacity drag, and recovery outputs when attributed hours meet or exceed available capacity
model.annual_cost_formula: round(annual burden hours × supplied average hourly cost)
model.capacity_drag_formula: round(annual burden hours ÷ total available capacity hours × 100)
model.recoverable_share_formula: interpolate within the score-band range using the worst measured clarity-gap severity

remedy_paths.label: Verify routine work
remedy_paths.summary: Check whether routine work in this structural boundary matches the documented roles, authority and handoffs.
actions: Within 30 days, ask the person responsible for this structure to review a routine work item. If exceptions are reported, check who owns them and who may make the decision.
remedy_paths.benefit: Records whether routine work follows the documented structure, without assuming an exception or defect exists.
remedy_paths.risk: An isolated sample may miss less common work.

remedy_paths.label: Check recent work
remedy_paths.summary: Compare role clarity in recent routine cases. Include non-routine cases only if they exist.
actions: Review five recent routine cases, and include exceptions if any are identified. Record whether any boundaries required clarification.
Correct a boundary only if the same ambiguity appears more than once.
remedy_paths.benefit: Shows whether clarification is needed within a bounded sample; it does not establish a general design weakness.
remedy_paths.risk: A small sample can overstate an unusual case; keep the test bounded and evidence-based.

remedy_paths.label: Set a change-readiness guardrail
remedy_paths.summary: Define the organizational changes that should trigger a focused clarity review for a structure in the instrument's current stronger range.
actions: Recheck role clarity after a material role, scope, governance, or staffing change.
Use the same measures for the next comparison. If exceptions were recorded, review those cases before deciding whether any structural change is warranted.
remedy_paths.benefit: Defines when the same clarity dimensions should be measured again after a material change.
remedy_paths.risk: Limitation: without a named trigger and owner, the review provides no observations between scheduled measurement points.
